cards.title: Chat to strangers and let your kids be bored: how to embrace a 'slow September'
cards.body: September pressure to optimize can lead to burnout for families. Instead of packed schedules, embrace slower routines and let children experience boredom, which has real developmental benefits.

cards.title: Teaching Our Children How to Use AI Safely
cards.body: As AI becomes more integrated into daily life, parents need practical strategies to help kids navigate this technology safely. Six family rules can help establish healthy boundaries and responsible use.

cards.title: Why more women carry the 'mental load' and how couples can share it
cards.body: Planning and organizing household tasks disproportionately falls to mothers, creating invisible burden. Couples can redistribute this mental load through communication and shared responsibility systems.

cards.title: Why House Mapping Can Save the ADHD Home
cards.body: House mapping helps ADHD families design spaces around how they naturally live, reducing clutter and mental fatigue. This approach works for any busy or overwhelmed household seeking organization.

cards.title: I'm giving birth as a battle rages over maternity care in Ireland
cards.body: Ireland's shift from a two-tier private/public maternity system to universal state care is affecting pregnant women's experiences. Safe, equitable access to maternity care remains a critical issue.
